summary: Completed Phase B API Key module verification. Created comprehensive unit tests (58 tests) and integration tests (41 tests) covering DTO validation, key generation, service methods, guard authentication, scope enforcement, and usage logging. All unit tests pass. Integration tests ready but skipped (no TEST_DATABASE_URL). Frontend build successful with API key management UI. All existing tests pass (no regressions).

backend_issues.notes: No backend issues found. All service methods, guard, interceptor, and DTO validation implement requirements correctly. Key generation uses 256-bit keys with 789k_ prefix and SHA-256 hashing. Secrets shown only once. Owner + tenant isolation enforced. 25 active keys limit. Scoped to /api/v1/automation routes only. All security requirements met.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend build successful. API key management UI at /dashboard/api-keys includes create/scopes/rotation/revoke/usage/reference tabs. Static preview mode correctly shows form disabled with 'PostgreSQL-backed account required' message. No fake keys generated. Example uses YOUR_KEY placeholder, not actual secrets. Responsive design works on mobile. Theme support present. Existing trunk and caller ID pages unchanged.

passed_tests: DTO Validation: 13 tests (valid data, name length, scopes validation, expiry range, unknown fields rejection)
Key Generation: 5 tests (789k_ prefix, 256-bit keys, SHA-256 hashing, uniqueness, no raw key in hash)
Service - list(): 3 tests (owner isolation, no hash/secret exposure, available scopes)
Service - create(): 9 tests (scope validation, 25 key limit, account status checks, hash storage, deduplication, audit logging)
Service - revoke(): 4 tests (owner checks, cross-tenant 404, idempotency, audit logging)
Service - rotate(): 5 tests (scope/expiry preservation, revoked/expired rejection, cross-tenant 404)
Service - usage(): 2 tests (owner isolation, no sensitive data exposure)
Service - recordUsage(): 3 tests (query param stripping, route/method truncation)
Service - authenticate(): 17 tests (format validation, revocation/expiry checks, orphaned owner, account status, scope enforcement, 401/403 logging, lastUsedAt update, principal return)
Integration tests: 41 tests created (skipped without TEST_DATABASE_URL) covering full CRUD, cross-tenant isolation, scope enforcement, usage logging, guard authentication
Frontend: Build successful, UI functional with all tabs, form validation, disabled state in preview mode, responsive design, theme support
Existing tests: All 357 tests still pass (no regressions)

dto_validation.valid_data: Validates CreateApiKeyDto with valid name, scopes, expiresInDays
dto_validation.name_validation: Rejects empty name (< 2 chars), name too long (> 80 chars), trims whitespace
dto_validation.scopes_validation: Rejects empty scopes array, invalid scopes (not in API_SCOPES), duplicate scopes, too many scopes (> 5)
dto_validation.unknown_fields: Rejects unknown fields with forbidNonWhitelisted (enforced by ValidationPipe)
dto_validation.all_scopes: Validates all 5 allowed scopes: trunks:read, trunks:write, cdr:read, balance:read, caller-id:read

key_generation.format: Generates keys with 789k_ prefix, 43 base64url chars (256-bit), 13-char prefix
key_generation.uniqueness: Each key generation produces unique key, hash, and prefix
key_generation.length: Keys are 48 chars total (5 prefix + 43 base64url = 32 bytes = 256 bits)
key_generation.hashing: Uses SHA-256 to hash keys, produces 64 hex char hash
key_generation.no_raw_storage: Hash does not contain raw key or prefix

service_list.owner_isolation: Returns only keys for organizationId + createdByUserId
service_list.no_secrets: List response excludes hash and key fields, only shows prefix
service_list.available_scopes: Returns API_SCOPES array with all allowed scopes

service_create.scope_validation: Rejects unsupported scopes, empty scopes array
service_create.key_limit: Enforces 25 active keys per user (revokedAt: null, expiresAt: null or future)
service_create.hash_storage: Stores SHA-256 hash, not raw key; hash does not contain key
service_create.account_status: Rejects if account is SUSPENDED or REJECTED
service_create.audit_logging: Creates audit log with API_KEY_CREATED action, metadata includes name/prefix/scopes
service_create.one_time_secret: Returns key with oneTime: true flag

service_revoke.owner_check: Revokes only if key matches organizationId + createdByUserId
service_revoke.cross_tenant: Returns 404 for keys from other organizations
service_revoke.idempotency: Returns revoked: true for already revoked keys without error
service_revoke.audit_logging: Creates audit log with API_KEY_REVOKED action

service_rotate.scope_preservation: New key inherits scopes and expiresAt from old key
service_rotate.revocation: Old key is revoked (revokedAt set) when rotation succeeds
service_rotate.rotation_link: New key has rotatedFromId pointing to old key
service_rotate.cross_tenant: Returns 404 for keys from other organizations

service_usage.owner_isolation: Returns logs only for keys where createdByUserId matches
service_usage.no_sensitive_data: Usage logs exclude requestBody, queryParams, headers
service_usage.limit: Returns latest 100 logs ordered by createdAt desc

service_record_usage.query_stripping: Strips query params from route (splits on '?')

service_authenticate.format_validation: Rejects invalid format, non-789k_ prefix, wrong length, non-string
service_authenticate.database_lookup: Returns 401 if key hash not found in database
service_authenticate.expiry_check: Rejects expired keys (expiresAt <= now), logs 401 status
service_authenticate.orphan_check: Rejects keys with null createdBy or mismatched organizationId
service_authenticate.account_status: Rejects keys for SUSPENDED or REJECTED accounts, logs 401
service_authenticate.scope_enforcement: Rejects if key lacks required scope, logs 403 status
service_authenticate.invalid_scope: Rejects if requested scope not in API_SCOPES, logs 403
service_authenticate.principal_return: Returns principal with owner details (id, organizationId, fullName, email, emailVerified, role) and key metadata (id, organizationId, prefix)

integration_tests.create_api_key: 8 tests - valid creation, secret shown once, empty/invalid scopes rejection, 25 key limit, deduplication, suspended account rejection, audit logging
integration_tests.list_api_keys: 3 tests - owner isolation, no hash/secret exposure, available scopes
integration_tests.rotate_api_key: 4 tests - scope/expiry preservation, revoked/expired rejection, cross-tenant 404
integration_tests.revoke_api_key: 4 tests - owner revocation, idempotency, cross-tenant 404, audit logging
integration_tests.usage_logs: 3 tests - owner isolation, no sensitive data, query param stripping
integration_tests.guard_authentication: 10 tests - valid key, invalid format, non-existent key, revoked key, expired key, suspended account, insufficient scope, lastUsedAt update, 401/403 logging
integration_tests.scope_enforcement: 7 tests - trunks:read for GET, trunks:write for POST, cdr:read, balance:read, caller-id:read, JWT management route rejection, admin route rejection
integration_tests.missing_scope_decorator: 1 test - verifies guard rejects routes without @KeyScope decorator

frontend_tests.page_load: Main heading, Create button, security info box, three tabs (keys, usage, reference)
frontend_tests.empty_state: Shows 'No API key records loaded' with database connection message
frontend_tests.reference_tab: Example curl command with X-API-Key header, YOUR_KEY placeholder (no actual secrets), permissions list with all 5 scopes
frontend_tests.usage_tab: Usage table with empty state message about database connection
frontend_tests.create_dialog: Name input, 5 scope checkboxes, expiry selector, submit button (disabled in preview), disabled reason message about PostgreSQL requirement
frontend_tests.existing_pages: SIP Trunks and Caller IDs pages unchanged and functional

verification_notes.key_generation: Verified: issueApiSecret generates 256-bit keys (32 bytes) with 789k_ prefix, SHA-256 hashing, unique keys each time.
verification_notes.secret_exposure: Verified: Secrets shown only once on create/rotate with oneTime: true. List/GET endpoints exclude hash and key fields.
verification_notes.owner_isolation: Verified: All operations filter by organizationId + createdByUserId. Cross-tenant access returns 404.
verification_notes.key_limit: Verified: Enforces 25 active keys per user (revokedAt: null, expiresAt: null or future).
verification_notes.scope_enforcement: Verified: Guard checks scope decorator on each route, rejects if missing or insufficient, logs 403.
verification_notes.account_status: Verified: Checks organization status on create and authenticate, rejects SUSPENDED/REJECTED with 403/401.
verification_notes.usage_logging: Verified: Interceptor logs method/route/status/prefix, strips query params, no request body/headers.
verification_notes.rotation: Verified: Rotation revokes old key, preserves scopes/expiry, creates new key with rotatedFromId link.
verification_notes.audit_logging: Verified: All operations (create/revoke/rotate) create audit log entries with action/targetId/metadata/IP.
verification_notes.jwt_isolation: Verified: API keys only work on /api/v1/automation routes with @Public + @UseGuards(ApiKeyGuard). JWT management routes require JWT auth.
verification_notes.frontend_offline: Verified: Frontend shows disabled state in preview mode, no fake keys generated, example uses YOUR_KEY placeholder.
verification_notes.no_regressions: Verified: All 357 existing tests pass, no changes to trunk or caller ID functionality.
